source(output(
		CLCL_ID as string,
		CLCL_ID_ADJ_FROM as string,
		PRIOR_FLAG as string,
		GRGR_CK as integer,
		CLCL_LAST_ACT_DTM as timestamp,
		CLCL_RECD_DT as timestamp,
		CLCL_INPUT_DT as timestamp,
		CLOSE_DT as timestamp,
		CLCL_CUR_STS as string,
		CURR_STS_BASE_FAC as string,
		TAT_BUS as integer,
		CLCL_ID_BASE_FAC as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT ODW.CLCL_ID 	,ODW.CLCL_ID_ADJ_FROM 	,PRIOR_FLAG = (CASE WHEN ODW.CLCL_ID_ADJ_FROM = \' \' THEN \'N\' ELSE \'Y\' END) 	,ERDB.CURRENT_STATUS CURR_STS_BASE_FAC 	,ERDB.TAT_BUS 	,ODW.GRGR_CK 	,ODW.CLCL_LAST_ACT_DTM 	,ODW.CLCL_RECD_DT 	,ODW.CLCL_INPUT_DT 	,ERDB.CLCL_ID CLCL_ID_BASE_FAC 	,ERDB.CLOSE_DT 	,CLCL_CUR_STS	 FROM ERDB.REPORTS.CLAIM_BASE_FAC ERDB (NOLOCK)      INNER JOIN REPORTS.FAC_CMC_CLCL_CLAIM ODW (NOLOCK) 		ON ODW.GRGR_CK = ERDB.GRGR_CK  		AND ODW.CLCL_ID = ERDB.CLCL_ID WHERE TAT_BUS IS NULL AND RECEIVED_DT > \'1/1/2000\' AND CLOSE_DT <= GETDATE() AND CURRENT_STATUS IN (\'PCC\', \'PDC\', \'PCZ\', \'PSC\', \'PTC\', \'PTZ\', \'VDZ\', \'DIZ\', \'DNZ\')',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> ClaimswithNULLTATBUS	source(output(
		CLCL_ID as string,
		CLCL_ID_ADJ_FROM as string,
		PRIOR_FLAG as string,
		GRGR_CK as integer,
		CLCL_LAST_ACT_DTM as timestamp,
		CLCL_RECD_DT as timestamp,
		CLCL_INPUT_DT as timestamp,
		CLCL_ID_BASE as string,
		CLOSE_DT as timestamp,
		CLCL_CUR_STS as string,
		CURRENT_STATUS as string,
		CKCK_PRINTED_DT as timestamp,
		PYMNT_INIT_DT as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT ODW.CLCL_ID ,ODW.CLCL_ID_ADJ_FROM ,PRIOR_FLAG = (CASE WHEN ODW.CLCL_ID_ADJ_FROM = \' \' THEN \'N\' ELSE \'Y\' END)     ,ODW.GRGR_CK ,ODW.CLCL_LAST_ACT_DTM ,ODW.CLCL_RECD_DT ,ODW.CLCL_INPUT_DT ,ERDB.CLCL_ID CLCL_ID_BASE ,ERDB.CLOSE_DT ,CLCL_CUR_STS ,ERDB.CURRENT_STATUS  ,DISB.CKCK_PRINTED_DT  ,ERDB.PYMNT_INIT_DT FROM ODW.DW.AGP_DISB_PAYMENT_IMPORT(NOLOCK) DISB  INNER JOIN ERDB.KBD.CLAIM_BASE_FAC_SUB (NOLOCK) ERDB  ON DISB.CLCL_ID = ERDB.CLCL_ID  AND DISB.CLAIM_IND = \'C\'  AND ERDB.PYMNT_INIT_DT <> DISB.CKCK_PRINTED_DT  AND DISB.LAST_MODIFIED_DTM BETWEEN ? AND ?  INNER JOIN ERDB.REPORTS.FAC_CMC_CLCL_CLAIM ODW (NOLOCK) ON ODW.GRGR_CK = ERDB.GRGR_CK  AND ODW.CLCL_ID = ERDB.CLCL_ID',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> FCSDMSOutofSyncclaims	source(output(
		CLCL_ID as string,
		CLCL_ID_ADJ_FROM as string,
		PRIOR_FLAG as string,
		GRGR_CK as integer,
		CLCL_LAST_ACT_DTM as timestamp,
		CLCL_RECD_DT as timestamp,
		CLCL_INPUT_DT as timestamp,
		CLCL_ID_BASE as string,
		CLOSE_DT as timestamp,
		CLCL_CUR_STS as string,
		CURRENT_STATUS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT odw.CLCL_ID             ,odw.CLCL_ID_ADJ_FROM             ,PRIOR_FLAG = (CASE WHEN ODW.CLCL_ID_ADJ_FROM = \' \' THEN \'N\' ELSE \'Y\' END)                 ,ODW.GRGR_CK             ,ODW.CLCL_LAST_ACT_DTM                      ,ODW.CLCL_RECD_DT             ,ODW.CLCL_INPUT_DT             ,ERDB.CLCL_ID CLCL_ID_BASE             ,ERDB.CLOSE_DT                      ,CLCL_CUR_STS             ,ERDB.CURRENT_STATUS  FROM REPORTS.FAC_CMC_CLCL_CLAIM ODW (NOLOCK)      LEFT JOIN ERDB.KBD.CLAIM_BASE_FAC_SUB ERDB (NOLOCK)        ON ODW.GRGR_CK = ERDB.GRGR_CK       AND ODW.CLCL_ID = ERDB.CLCL_ID WHERE ODW.CLCL_LAST_ACT_DTM BETWEEN ? AND ?  AND     ERDB.CLCL_ID IS NULL',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> MissingClaims	source(output(
		CLCL_ID as string,
		CLCL_ID_ADJ_FROM as string,
		PRIOR_FLAG as string,
		GRGR_CK as integer,
		CLCL_LAST_ACT_DTM as timestamp,
		CLCL_RECD_DT as timestamp,
		CLCL_INPUT_DT as timestamp,
		CLCL_ID_BASE as string,
		CLOSE_DT as timestamp,
		CLCL_CUR_STS as string,
		CURRENT_STATUS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT odw.CLCL_ID             ,odw.CLCL_ID_ADJ_FROM             ,PRIOR_FLAG = (CASE WHEN ODW.CLCL_ID_ADJ_FROM = \' \' THEN \'N\' ELSE \'Y\' END)                 ,ODW.GRGR_CK             ,ODW.CLCL_LAST_ACT_DTM             ,ODW.CLCL_RECD_DT             ,ODW.CLCL_INPUT_DT             ,ERDB.CLCL_ID CLCL_ID_BASE             ,ERDB.CLOSE_DT             ,CLCL_CUR_STS             ,ERDB.CURRENT_STATUS  FROM ERDB.REPORTS.CLAIM_BASE_FAC ERDB (NOLOCK)      INNER JOIN REPORTS.FAC_CMC_CLCL_CLAIM ODW (NOLOCK)        ON ODW.GRGR_CK = ERDB.GRGR_CK       AND ODW.CLCL_ID = ERDB.CLCL_ID WHERE ODW.CLCL_LAST_ACT_DTM BETWEEN ? AND ? AND  NOT        (               (CLCL_CUR_STS = \'01\' AND CURRENT_STATUS = \'IPZ\') OR               (CLCL_CUR_STS = \'02\' AND CURRENT_STATUS IN (\'PDC\', \'PCC\', \'PCZ\', \'PTC\', \'PTZ\', \'PSC\', \'PSZ\', \'DNZ\', \'DIZ\',\'PLZ\',\'PXZ\')) OR                (CLCL_CUR_STS IN (\'10\',\'11\', \'15\', \'16\') AND CURRENT_STATUS = \'INZ\') OR               (CLCL_CUR_STS = \'91\' AND CURRENT_STATUS IN (\'DNZ\', \'PDC\', \'PTC\', \'PCC\', \'PTZ\', \'DIZ\',\'PLZ\',\'PXZ\')) OR                 (CLCL_CUR_STS IN (\'93\', \'97\', \'99\') AND CURRENT_STATUS = \'VDZ\') OR               (CLCL_CUR_STS IN (\'19\', \'88\',\'95\') AND CURRENT_STATUS = \'OTH\') OR               (CLCL_CUR_STS IN (\'01\',\'02\',\'11\',\'15\') AND CURRENT_STATUS = \'VDZ\') OR               (CLCL_CUR_STS IN (\'01\',\'11\',\'15\') AND (CURRENT_STATUS LIKE \'P%\' AND  CURRENT_STATUS LIKE \'D%\'))         );',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OutofSyncclaims
ClaimswithNULLTATBUS sink(input(
		CLCL_RECD_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		GRGR_CK as integer,
		CLCL_INPUT_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CLCL_ID_ADJ_FROM as string,
		CLCL_LAST_ACT_DTM as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		TAT_BUS as integer,
		PRIOR_FLAG as string,
		CLCL_ID_BASE_FAC as string,
		CLCL_ID as string,
		CLOSE_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CLCL_CUR_STS as string,
		CURR_STS_BASE_FAC as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CLCL_RECD_DT,
		GRGR_CK,
		CLCL_INPUT_DT,
		CLCL_ID_ADJ_FROM,
		CLCL_LAST_ACT_DTM,
		TAT_BUS,
		PRIOR_FLAG,
		CLCL_ID_BASE_FAC,
		CLCL_ID,
		CLOSE_DT,
		CLCL_CUR_STS,
		CURR_STS_BASE_FAC)) ~> NullsLogfile
FCSDMSOutofSyncclaims sink(input(
		CLCL_RECD_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		GRGR_CK as integer,
		CLCL_LAST_ACT_DTM as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PRIOR_FLAG as string,
		CKCK_PRINTED_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CLCL_ID as string,
		CLCL_ID_BASE as string,
		CURRENT_STATUS as string,
		CLCL_INPUT_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CLCL_ID_ADJ_FROM as string,
		PYMNT_INIT_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CLOSE_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CLCL_CUR_STS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CLCL_RECD_DT,
		GRGR_CK,
		CLCL_LAST_ACT_DTM,
		PRIOR_FLAG,
		CKCK_PRINTED_DT,
		CLCL_ID,
		CLCL_ID_BASE,
		CURRENT_STATUS,
		CLCL_INPUT_DT,
		CLCL_ID_ADJ_FROM,
		PYMNT_INIT_DT,
		CLOSE_DT,
		CLCL_CUR_STS)) ~> FCSDMSOutofSyncLogFile
MissingClaims sink(input(
		CLCL_RECD_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CURRENT_STATUS as string,
		GRGR_CK as integer,
		CLCL_INPUT_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CLCL_ID_ADJ_FROM as string,
		CLCL_LAST_ACT_DTM as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PRIOR_FLAG as string,
		CLCL_ID as string,
		CLCL_ID_BASE as string,
		CLOSE_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CLCL_CUR_STS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CLCL_RECD_DT,
		CURRENT_STATUS,
		GRGR_CK,
		CLCL_INPUT_DT,
		CLCL_ID_ADJ_FROM,
		CLCL_LAST_ACT_DTM,
		PRIOR_FLAG,
		CLCL_ID,
		CLCL_ID_BASE,
		CLOSE_DT,
		CLCL_CUR_STS)) ~> MissingLogFile
FCSDMSOutofSyncclaims,MissingClaims,ClaimswithNULLTATBUS,OutofSyncclaims union(byName: true) ~> UnionAll
OutofSyncclaims sink(input(
		CLCL_RECD_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CURRENT_STATUS as string,
		GRGR_CK as integer,
		CLCL_INPUT_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CLCL_ID_ADJ_FROM as string,
		CLCL_LAST_ACT_DTM as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		PRIOR_FLAG as string,
		CLCL_ID as string,
		CLCL_ID_BASE as string,
		CLOSE_DT as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CLCL_CUR_STS as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CLCL_RECD_DT,
		CURRENT_STATUS,
		GRGR_CK,
		CLCL_INPUT_DT,
		CLCL_ID_ADJ_FROM,
		CLCL_LAST_ACT_DTM,
		PRIOR_FLAG,
		CLCL_ID,
		CLCL_ID_BASE,
		CLOSE_DT,
		CLCL_CUR_STS)) ~> OutofSyncLogFile
UnionAll sink(input(
		CLCL_ID_ADJ_FROM as string,
		PRIOR_FLAG as string,
		CLCL_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		CLCL_ID_ADJ_FROM,
		PRIOR_FLAG,
		CLCL_ID)) ~> FAC1RUploadFile
